citation: "The Complete History of the First and Second Fort Dearborn in Chicago." Digital Research Library of Illinois History Journal, June 2018.
note: Used here for ONE thing: the dated table of commandants of the second fort, which is the finest-grained garrison chronology reached and which brackets 1835-07-01 inside Maj. John Greene's command (18 December 1833 to 16 September 1835). That reading does not rest on this page alone - Andreas vol. 1 p. 84 independently gives the same two dates as the ends of DeLafayette Wilcox's two commands and names Greene among the officers who held the post between them, so the bracket is corroborated by a source with a page. Like the other drloihjournal pages in this dataset it is UNFOOTNOTED and must never be sole evidence. It reproduces Captain John Whistler's 1808 plan of the FIRST fort, which is not evidence for the second and is not used as such here.
access_notes: Unfootnoted blogspot compilation. Its architectural detail for the second fort is entirely the 1855 photograph key and the Wau-Bun paragraph, both of which this project cites at their own sources instead.
what_it_supplies: the commandants of the second fort with dates, 1832-1836
the date of the final evacuation, 29 December 1836
what_it_does_not_supply: any independent architectural evidence for the second fort
